name: code_parallel_build_forks
description: Deterministic code_parallel decision step, replacing a JSON_JQ_TRANSFORM.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the repo checkout, passed through unchanged as each generated fork's repoPath input.

id.description: Subtask identifier; used as the fork's group id and taskReferenceName. Entries with a blank/missing id are skipped.

description.description: Subtask description folded into the generated fork's prompt text.

files.description: Target files the fork is scoped to; also becomes that fork's allowedWriteRoots.

subtasks.description: Validated plan entries. One dynamic-fork SUB_WORKFLOW task is built per entry that has a non-empty id.

changeDir.description: Planning context directory referenced in the generated subtask prompt text.

codeModel.description: Model identifier passed through unchanged as each fork's 'model' input.

codePromptTemplate.description: Prompt template passed through unchanged as each fork's promptTemplate input.

codePromptTemplateSource.description: Source label for the prompt template, passed through unchanged.

specContextPath.description: Path to the spec/design context file, passed through unchanged to each fork.

contextPaths.description: Extra live context paths passed through unchanged to each fork. Accepts a comma-separated string or an array of strings.

maxTurns.description: Max agent turns, passed through unchanged as each fork's maxTurns input.

maxBudgetUsd.description: USD budget ceiling, passed through unchanged as each fork's maxBudgetUsd input.

modelProfile.description: Model profile name, passed through unchanged to each fork.

modelPolicy.description: Inline model policy document, passed through unchanged to each fork.

modelPolicySource.description: Source label for the model policy, passed through unchanged.

modelPolicySha256.description: Expected sha256 of the inline model policy, passed through unchanged.

modelsConfig.description: Relative path to a repository models config, passed through unchanged.

modelOverrides.description: Per-agent model overrides, passed through unchanged to each fork.

dynamicTasks.description: One SUB_WORKFLOW dynamic-fork task descriptor per subtask with a non-empty id, for use as FORK_JOIN_DYNAMIC's dynamicForkTasksParam.

dynamicTasksInput.description: Map of subtask id to that fork's full code_subtask input payload, for use as FORK_JOIN_DYNAMIC's dynamicForkTasksInputParamName.

groupIds.description: Comma-separated list of subtask ids that were turned into forks, in order.

allowedWriteRoots.description: Sorted, de-duplicated union of every fork's target files.
